# weka_object_store_bucket (Data Source)

Look up an existing object store bucket by UID or name. The API only returns the secret key when it is not masked, so it is often null here.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `id` (String) Object store bucket UID. Exactly one of id or name is required.
- `name` (String) Object store bucket name. Exactly one of id or name is required.

### Read-Only

- `access_key_id` (String) Access key ID for AWS Signature authentication.
- `auth_method` (String) Authentication method.
- `bucket` (String) Bucket name in the object store.
- `hostname` (String) Hostname or IP of the object store endpoint.
- `obs_name` (String) Object store this bucket belongs to.
- `obs_site` (String) Site of the bucket (local or remote).
- `obs_type` (String) Object store type.
- `port` (Number) Port of the object store endpoint.
- `protocol` (String) Protocol used to reach the object store.
- `region` (String) Region the bucket is assigned to.
- `secret_key` (String, Sensitive) Secret key for AWS Signature authentication, when the API does not mask it.
